_what: THE INTAKE GATE for Zhao et al. 2020 (PMID 32662132), filled BEFORE any digitiser or enumerator was written (PIPELINE_V2.md section 3, stage 00b). One entry per panel that could supply a per-member value.
endpoint: mRNA delivery. Two readouts: (i) firefly-luciferase expression (RLU) in primary human CD8+ T lymphocytes 6 h after FLuc mRNA delivery; (ii) percent EGFP-positive primary human CD8+ T lymphocytes by flow cytometry. In vivo: FLuc IVIS and Cre-recombinase/tdTomato recombination in mouse spleen. In scope for the corpus.
verdict: NO PER-MEMBER VALUE SOURCE FOR THE LIBRARY SCREEN EXISTS WITHIN REACH. The screen that the paper is about -- 18 amine heads x up to 8 tails -- is plotted ONLY in the main-text figures, and the main text is behind the Wiley subscription wall with no open copy anywhere. The Supporting Information, which is the one asset we hold, contains delivery values for exactly TWO lipidoids (93-O17S and 9322-O17S) and NO library screen at all. It is, however, an unusually strong STRUCTURE source: five tails are synthesised from named reagents in its own text (tier 4).

what_is_acquirable.held: source/anie202008082-sup-0001-misc_information.pdf, 11 pages, sha256 a48c7f5b9f7e9b5c1f0ab165668db0a6bd28963015eb9785d1b7870180aaca8a, fetched from onlinelibrary.wiley.com/action/downloadSupplement. Wiley serves the SI to an unauthenticated request; it does not serve the article.
what_is_acquirable.not_held: the main article (Figures 1-4), which carries every library delivery value.

why_tier_1_fails.verdict: No publisher Source Data file exists, and the one supplementary asset Wiley publishes for this DOI is the PDF we hold.
why_tier_1_fails.evidence: Angewandte Chemie had no Source Data programme in 2020. The SI's own Table of Contents lists three items (Experimental Procedures p2-3, Supplemental Results and Discussions p4-10, Supplemental References p11) and no data file. The article has no data-availability statement.

why_tier_2_fails.verdict: The SI contains no value table of any kind. All 11 pages were read as text and every figure is a single flattened raster.
why_tier_2_fails.measured: pymupdf get_text() over all 11 pages: page 1 title (239 chars), pages 2-3 Experimental Procedures (5,296 + 6,467 chars), pages 4-10 figure captions only (152-516 chars each), page 11 references (746 chars). get_images() returns exactly ONE content raster per figure page plus the recurring 404x102 journal banner. get_drawings() returns 1-5 vector items per figure page, all page furniture, none belonging to a plot -- so there is no tier-4b geometry either. pdfplumber find_tables() flags pages 2 and 3; both are running prose, not tables, and the thin-filled-rect recovery path (triage.py ruled_tables) reports 0 pages on the whole document.
why_tier_2_fails.contents_page_was_checked_independently: The run brief warns that an SI contents page can produce a false zero. Every page was enumerated directly rather than trusted to the contents list; the enumeration agrees with the contents list and adds nothing.

why_tier_3_fails.verdict: No author repository, and no open copy of the article.
why_tier_3_fails.evidence: OpenAlex for doi:10.1002/anie.202008082 returns open_access.is_oa=false, oa_status 'closed', any_repository_has_fulltext=false, and only two locations (the Wiley landing page and the PubMed record), neither with a pdf_url. Unpaywall returns is_oa=false, oa_status 'closed', zero oa_locations. Europe PMC core record has inEPMC=N, pmcid=null, and /fullTextXML returns HTTP 404. NCBI esearch in db=pmc returns count=0 for the DOI and count=0 for the quoted title in [TITLE]; the 60 hits for the bare title string are citing articles' reference lists. elink pubmed->pmc returns only pubmed_pmc_refs (65 citing PMCIDs), i.e. no author manuscript was ever deposited despite the NIH-Extramural pubType.
why_tier_3_fails.paywall_posture: https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/{pdf,epdf,full-xml}/10.1002/anie.202008082 each return HTTP 403 to a plain client. No bot check and no login was attempted: the run brief forbids the shared browser and the project forbids paywall bypass. This is recorded as a hard stop, not as a retryable failure.

why_tier_4_is_THE_STRUCTURE_SOURCE_AND_N.verdict: The SI's Experimental Procedures are a PDF text layer and they contain the complete synthesis of five tails from named reagents with gram/millimole pairs. That is tier-4 STRUCTURE evidence of the best kind. It contains no delivery numbers.
why_tier_4_is_THE_STRUCTURE_SOURCE_AND_N.printed_delivery_numbers_in_the_SI_text: none. The Experimental Procedures print doses and protocol constants only (0.5 ug FLuc mRNA per well, 5 ug lipidoid per well, 1.7 and 17 ug/mL final, 6 h, 25,000 cells; in vivo 0.6 mg/kg mRNA + 6 mg/kg lipidoid IV, 6 h; Cre 15 ug mRNA + 150 ug lipidoid, two injections 5 days apart, read at day 10).
why_tier_4_is_THE_STRUCTURE_SOURCE_AND_N.one_printed_outcome: the Abstract states 8.2 % gene recombination in mouse T lymphocytes for the lead lipidoid in vivo. That is a single number for a single lipidoid and is recorded in 05_values.csv as a printed statistic, not as an extraction.

panels.panel: Figure S3 -- flow cytometry histograms, percent GFP+ printed INSIDE each histogram
panels.source_file: source/...sup-0001...pdf page 6, embedded raster xref 106, 1534 x 1279 px
panels.what: 93-O17S and 9322-O17S, each at 5 / 15 / 30 / 60 ug/mL lipidoid, plus LF2000 at 5 ug/mL and untreated. EGFP mRNA, primary human CD8+ T lymphocytes.
panels.why_this_is_the_best_thing_in_the_docume: the numbers are PRINTED, at a glyph height of ~28 px. Transcription, not estimation. No axis, no calibration, no geometry -- none of error classes 20/27/32/33 can reach it.
panels.why_not_a_higher_tier: tiers 1-4 fail as recorded above; these ten numbers are published nowhere else.

panels.panel: Figure S2a -- Luminescence (RLU) of 93-O17S at 12 excipient ratios + untreated
panels.trap_1_note: This is the run brief's trap 1 in its purest form: 12 individually measured FORMULATIONS of ONE structure. It is not 12 lipids.
panels.what_makes_it_calibratable: linear y axis, five labelled ticks at 0/2000/4000/6000/8000, a drawn spine, solid single-colour dark-grey bars.
hazards: every bar carries a symmetric s.d. whisker with a cap -- bars.bar_top's left/right flank agreement is the defence (F-018, error class 32)
the bars are near-black and so is the axis rule and the text; the ink mask must be built on the bar's own fill and bounded away from the axis

panels.panel: Figure S2c -- Luminescence (RLU) of 93-O17S at 7 timepoints + untreated; Figure S2d -- at 5 lipidoid concentrations + untreated
panels.note: same single structure as S2a. Time course and dose response, not a library.

panels.panel: Figure S4 -- pKa by TNS assay; Figure S5 -- relative hemolysis
panels.why_not_as_values: pKa is a physicochemical property and hemolysis is a toxicity readout. Neither is a delivery endpoint. The corpus definition excludes both -- 90 hemolysis_percent rows were removed from the in-vitro pool when it was trimmed (CLAUDE.md section 9, 2026-07-23).
panels.what_they_ARE_good_for: their x-axis category labels and legends are legible and together they enumerate the library's NAMES: 17 '93xx' analogue heads plus the parent head 93, against 3 tails in the top panels and 7 (Fig S4) or 8 (Fig S5) in the bottom. Recorded in 04_library_membership.csv. The per-head TAIL MEMBERSHIP is REFUSED, with the segmentation numbers, because bars inside a head group touch and separating them needs colour clustering that these non-emitted panels do not justify.

panels.panel: Figure S1 -- ESI-MS of head 9322 with six tails
panels.tier: 5_pixels (peak POSITION against the m/z axis, not the label glyphs)
panels.why_not: THE GLYPH READ IS STILL REFUSED and that part of the first pass stands: the base-peak labels are 5-7 px tall (boxes 18-25 px wide) and stay illegible at 28x LANCZOS. What was WRONG was treating that as the end of the panel. With head 9322 recovered from the corpus the question stopped being 'what is this number' and became 'which of three candidates 20 and 30 Da apart is it', and a 3.93 Da/px axis answers that: 764.73 at 0.20 px, 784.73 at 4.89 px, 794.75 at 7.44 px. 2 of 6 panels calibrate under criteria that cannot be tuned to the answer; 4 refuse and were not rescued by loosening a threshold.
panels.what_would_fix_it: the main article's Figure 1 or 2, which draws the heads.
panels.what_it_now_supports: head 9322 = 1-(3-aminopropyl)-2-methylimidazole, confirmed in this paper's own data at an 18.9x margin against the plain-imidazole alternative; and a derived per-arm mass of 310.19 +/- 1.99 Da for the otherwise unknown O17C tail, which EXCLUDES a carbonate (-74.1 Da) and is consistent with a plain C17 alkyl acrylate (-0.1 Da) without pinning it (D-4 stays open).

panels.panel: Figures S6 / S7 / S8 -- IVIS images, confocal micrographs, flow gating
panels.why_not: no numeric scale on any of them. The run brief's trap 3. S6 is a bioluminescence image plate with no colour bar numbers legible, S7 is confocal tdTomato imagery, S8 is a gating strategy.

structures_vs_formulations_vs_measured.explanation: 18 heads x the tails each was screened against is the paper's library, and its size is not stated anywhere in the SI. TWO heads are enumerable - 93 and 9322, both from corpus attestation under the guarded lookup, neither drawn in this paper - against the five tails whose synthesis the SI gives, so 10 structures are built. The other SIXTEEN heads have zero corpus attestation and the paper states no digit grammar, so they are not enumerable and none is invented. Both lipidoids that carry a reachable delivery value now have a structure. The 38 delivery datapoints are 10 from Figure S3, 14 from S2a, 8 from S2c and 5 from S2d (6 of them controls) plus the abstract's single in-vivo figure. 13 are emitted as corpus rows: the Figure S2a formulations of 93-O17S.
